# Test fixtures — generated, never committed as binaries (M0.5)

Everything under `tests/` that plays the role of a fixture is **generated by
code at test time** (README §12.2: fixtures must be small, deterministic,
assertable). No binary blobs live in this directory; a 0-byte or truncated
"corrupt" media file is produced by writing real media with `vcac.media` and
then cutting it, so the fixture's provenance is the test that builds it.

Golden content hashes live in the test files that assert them
(`tests/e2e/test_routes.py`, `tests/e2e/test_small_cases.py`) — human-confirmed
snapshots, updated only on an intentional generator change.
